propositions: sign-review deterministically fails with store-read-failure on valid PASS verdicts when unrelated untracked files exist in the shared tracker
resign.py:146 calls generation.collect without ignore_untracked=True, causing tracker_head_sha to run strict git status (untracked INCLUDED) that fails on any untracked path

four sites in the codebase (resign.py:146, orchestrator.py:650, attest.py:139, attest.py:406) must pass ignore_untracked=True to tolerate untracked tracker files as a committed-head fingerprint should

the fix is a regression of bug d7cb-22ae, which established the contract that signing must tolerate unrelated untracked shared-tracker files and cannot weaken real guarantees (tracked-dirty must still fail)
concurrent sessions sharing a symlinked .tickets-tracker directory experience machine-wide signing collapse when one session has in-flight atomic writes leaving temporary untracked files
the orchestrator drift-refresh probe silently falls back to full multi-pass LLM re-review (instead of cheap probe) when untracked files exist, due to swallowed Exception
